text:
amna: Heads-up — we're hitting quota limits in us-west-2 when trying to provision a new inference cluster. P4d and p5 capacity requests are being throttled and NAT gateway SNAT port exhaustion is causing pod egress failures. Opened a support case with AWS: case 12345678901. Can someone coordinate escalation?

lee: Thanks, amna. What's the current error when provisioning? Is it ENI limit or instance-type quota?

amna: Mostly instance-type quota for p4d and p5 (Requests are "InsufficientInstanceCapacity" and API returns 401 quota limit). Also noticed error logs: `NetworkError: no available ephemeral ports` in controller logs. NAT scaling isn't kicking in because our VPC elastic IP pool is exhausted.

tyler: I'll pull the exact error logs and the quota screenshots. We should ask AWS for both vCPU and instance type increases, plus request a soft limit bump for ENIs and attachment count. Also request expedited review — this is blocking a customer demo tomorrow.

sasha: FYI we also have a concurrent GCP onboarding that hit their external IP quota in us-west1 last week — lesson: include cost justification and traffic pattern to avoid back-and-forth. I'll draft the justification.

amna: @tyler please post the AWS console screenshots here when you have them. @sasha — can you write the cost/usage justification? We'll need billing owner signoff.

tyler: Screenshots attached to case 12345678901 (see AWS case URL: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#/case/?displayId=12345678901). Key ask: p4d: increase from 0->8, p5: 0->4 in us-west-2, ENI quota +100, and increase NAT public IP quota by 10. Marked as urgent.

gcp-case-bot: Automated reminder — include project billing ID and last 30d usage graphs when requesting quota increases on GCP. Links: https://console.cloud.google.com/iam-admin/settings.

lee: I'll ping our AWS TAM and the AM directly. Also open a parallel ticket with account team asking for spot capacity reservations or host placement if needed.

infra-oncall: Quick checklist: 1) Confirm billing owner (sam.billing) signs justification. 2) Add traffic profile (expected concurrent connections, burst windows). 3) Provide cluster autoscaler min/max and node label rationale. 4) Share deployment time window for reserved capacity.

amna: Billing signoff confirmed — sam.billing approved via email at 15:12. Sam will be CC'd on the case.

tyler: Submitted additional details to AWS support and requested P1 escalation. AWS response: "Case 12345678901 — currently in review, estimated response 4-6 hours. Provisioning may be limited by regional capacity, we will contact the regional capacity team." Attaching their note.

sasha: Drafted justification: 'Customer demo requires sustained 300 concurrent streams at 4k tokens/min, estimated peak vCPU 1024, sustained network egress 15 Gbps. Cost estimate attached.' Will paste into the case.

lee: If AWS delays, fallback plan: 1) move demo to eu-west-1 where we have spare p4d quota, 2) use mixed instance families (a2 + p4d mixed) as temporary. Which is least risky?

amna: EU move is possible but adds 120ms RT; demo needs <150ms p95 — borderline. Mixed families might be acceptable if we pin model to a smaller sequence length. Let's hold until AWS gives official ETA.

gcp-case-bot: Note: For GCP you can request quota via console APIs. Example command: `gcloud compute regions describe us-west1 --project=my-project` — include in the request.

tyler: AWS just replied — case escalated to "regional capacity team" and they asked for expected start window (we put 2026-06-08 09:00 UTC) and confirmed billing contact. They also asked for list of AMIs and InstanceProfile roles which we provided.

lee: I called the TAM and left a voicemail requesting a callback. Also created internal refresh: ticket #INFRA-4721 to track this with oncall.

amna: Quick update for the thread: provisioning failures have stopped for new small test nodes after we added 2 spare elastic IPs and increased NAT gateway scaling policy, but large instances still blocked.

tyler: AWS follow-up: regional capacity looked at p4d availability and suggested a phased rollout: 2 x p4d now (within 8 hours) and the rest pending capacity (up to 72 hours). They've prioritized our case because of TAM note.

sasha: Great — I'll notify the product team and customer success to adjust the demo to use the 2 available p4d nodes and fallback mixed nodes for scaling. Drafting a short note.

infra-oncall: Action items assigned: tyler -> monitor AWS case and post updates here; lee -> keep TAM/AM looped; sasha -> notify teams and prepare demo fallback doc; amna -> confirm post-change health checks.

amna: Thanks everyone. I'll update once AWS confirms the full quota increase. :thumbsup:

tyler: AWS updated case 12345678901 — they've provisioned 2 p4d instances in us-west-2 immediately. Remaining quota increase pending. Case now shows status: "In Progress - Regional Capacity Team". Next ETA provided: 2026-06-10 18:00 UTC.

lee: Noted. I'll schedule a short warroom at 17:30 UTC on 2026-06-10 to verify cluster scale and failover behavior.

amna: Thread closed for now, will reopen if anything changes.

(incident-bot): This thread was tagged as priority-by-impact.
